data.summary_suggestion: Search and filter emission factors across sources
data.description_suggestion: Retrieves emission factors from DEFRA, EPA, ADEME, and Ember databases. Supports filtering by category, scope, source, and search terms. Pass source=list to retrieve available sources and years instead of factor rows. Returns a FactorResponse containing matching emission factors with their units, values (CO2e, CO2, CH4, N2O), and metadata. Factors are normalized to a common schema across all four sources.
